verdict.rationale: A community user credits Cua-Bench with trajectory export, and the Cua Volume docs mention an audit log, so there is some first-party after-the-fact record. Nothing documents that a run's steps, screenshots and injected inputs are captured and replayable for an operator. Watching, streaming and taking over a Space are live-only and do not count as post-run review. Missing for 10: documented per-run replay or recording, captured screens per step, logged injected keyboard/mouse inputs, trajectory capture outside benchmark runs, first-party docs on trajectory export contents.

support.subject: As an operator, every run is reviewable afterwards: the steps taken, the screens seen, and the inputs injected

citations.quote: Praised Cua-Bench's trajectory export as smart: evaluation and training data collection in the same tool.
